doc: Music cues and where they play (M2-AUD-02; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md). cues: id -> file (one stream) or stems (synchronized layers of equal length; start_stems are audible at the start, the rest start silent), volume_db (0: assets ship at -16 LUFS), resume (a cue that comes back, after a battle say, carries on from where it stopped). Looping comes from each file's import settings (render_all.py writes them from the .loop.json sidecars). zones: scene -> the zone's music and ambience beds, switched under the router's fade (SceneRouter.scene_swapping). A missing `music` key leaves the music as it is; "silence" fades it out. variants: the first whose `flag` is set replaces the row's keys. battle: the cue per encounter (else default), and phases: an engine phase_changed id -> the stems to bring in or take out over sec. Cue ids are the .dlg @music ids (vertical_slice.md §6). tools/validate_data.py checks every file, scene and flag. A cue's `beat` (M3-AUD-864) is its beat grid for MusicDeck's on-the-beat changes, {bpm, downbeat_offset_s} from its source, when its file has no .loop.json; "free" marks an unmetered piece (sung, rubato or a drone), which a change leaves at once.
